projects.projectName: Vivli - Researcher Experience Modernization & Workflow Automation

riskDescription.context: RISK-816 is open in EMS with status Identified, raised 24 Sep 2026, describing 'Vivli Test data' as a Technical/Data corruption risk with Very High impact and organizational impact of Data Loss.
riskDescription.condition: Test data integrity issues may persist or escalate if mitigation actions remain at the Identified stage without execution.
riskDescription.consequence: Data loss could compromise project deliverables, delay go-live readiness, and erode client trust in data handling capabilities.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement automated test data validation checks with daily integrity reports to prevent data corruption escalation.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of data corruption, activate backup test dataset restoration within 4 hours and escalate to Engineering Manager.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk with Major severity, Very Likely likelihood, Very High impact, and Data Loss organizational impact; due date 24 Oct 2026 has passed with no closure or mitigation status change (EMS). Limited by lack of ALT context and Project Artifacts detail.

riskDescription.context: Project status remains Storming across all 22 biweekly reports from 11 Jun through 08 Nov 2026, with SOW end date of 30 Sep 2026 now passed and no documented extension, closure, or transition plan in EMS.
riskDescription.condition: The project may continue operating beyond its contracted period without formal approval, scope adjustment, or commercial amendment.
riskDescription.consequence: Uncontrolled scope creep, budget overruns, or contractual disputes could arise, and client expectations may misalign with delivery capacity.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal SOW extension approval process with client and document scope boundaries to prevent uncontrolled scope creep.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If contract extension is not approved by 30 Nov 2026, initiate project closure procedures and redirect resources.
risks.reasoning: SOW end date passed with no extension or closure recorded; status unchanged for five months post-SOW end (EMS biweekly reports through 08 Nov 2026). Limited by missing Project Artifacts and ALT context on commercial decisions.

riskDescription.context: Zero headcount (offshore: 0, onshore: 0, nearshore: 0, total: 0) is recorded across all 22 biweekly reports from 11 Jun through 08 Nov 2026, and Engineering Manager is listed as AavaSecurity ScanAutomation (a system/automation account) from 20 Aug 2026.
riskDescription.condition: Actual resource allocation may be untracked in EMS, or the project may lack sufficient staffing to execute modernization and automation deliverables.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery capacity could be insufficient to meet scope, leading to delays, quality issues, or unplanned attrition impact if resources are present but unmanaged.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct resource allocation audit with Primary DE POC and update EMS headcount records weekly to ensure accurate capacity tracking.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When delivery capacity shortfall is confirmed, engage offshore resource pool within 2 weeks and notify Circle Head immediately.
risks.reasoning: Persistent zero headcount and system account as EM suggest data entry gap or resource tracking outside EMS; no contradictory evidence in available sources (EMS). Limited by missing Project Artifacts and ALT context on actual team composition.

riskDescription.context: All RAG dimensions (overall, scope, cost, timeline, quality, talent, CSAT) are null across 22 biweekly reports from 11 Jun through 08 Nov 2026, and no observations, assumptions, dependencies, or progress metrics are documented in EMS.
riskDescription.condition: Project health visibility may be absent or tracked outside EMS, preventing early detection of delivery issues or escalation triggers.
riskDescription.consequence: Undetected scope, cost, or quality deterioration could surface late, limiting corrective action windows and increasing client dissatisfaction risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement weekly RAG status reporting with defined thresholds and populate EMS governance fields to enable proactive risk detection.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should critical delivery issue surface without prior RAG indication, escalate to Circle Head within 24 hours and initiate recovery plan.
risks.reasoning: Comprehensive absence of health indicators across five months of reporting suggests either data entry gap or health tracking outside EMS (EMS biweekly reports). Limited by missing Project Artifacts and ALT context on actual project health.
